description: Mandatory boundary test (Section 27, 'PAYG Scale 2 Medicare transition'): x around $538/$673, the Medicare Levy shade-in bands embedded in Scale 2. Weekly gross $600 -> x=600.99, in the [538,673) band (a=0.25, b=108.2135). y = 0.25*600.99 - 108.2135 = 42.034, rounds to 42.
source: ZP-TAX-AU-2026-27-001 v1.0 Section 6 (NAT 1004, Scale 2) and Section 27 (mandatory boundary test 'PAYG Scale 2 Medicare transition').
